remarks: Downtown! Urban living at it's best in this 1 bedroom 1 bath condo in great PreWar building. Stores and restaurants within walking distance, making this location an unmatched convenience. Low HOA fees includes heat and hot water.  One reserved parking space included. Basement storage unit adds convenience. Inside, the living area offers an inviting space. Generously sized bedroom with ample closet space providing a peaceful retreat along with an additional bonus office/den. Don't miss the chance to embrace the downtown Stamford lifestyle!
